title: Buildings or structures without elevator service where Type B+NYC units are required.
officialText: In buildings or structures where no elevator service is provided or required by other sections of this code, only the dwelling units and sleeping units that are located on stories indicated in Section 1107.7.4.1.1 are required to be Type B+NYC units.
